description: This file defines a wizard interface for setting filter fields in a report creation module within an Odoo (formerly OpenERP) system. It includes form definitions, domain setting functions, operator configuration, and a class implementing a multi-state wizard for selecting and configuring filter criteria.

classes.name: set_filter_fields
classes.description: A wizard interface class implementing a multi-state wizard for setting report filter fields.

methods.name: _set_field_domain
methods.description: Sets the domain for the 'field_id' selection based on the current model and context.

methods.name: set_field_operator
methods.description: Configures the search operator and value list based on field type and search operator.

methods.name: _set_filter_value
methods.description: Creates a filter record based on the selected field, operator, and value.

methods.name: _set_form_value
methods.description: Prepares form data for the selected field, including operator options and default values.

methods.name: _set_operator
methods.description: Configures available operators for the selected field type.
